title: Outfit package inspection
description: Review a UnityPackage, Booth ZIP/folder, or loose prefab folder in a dedicated read-only child session. Required in params: packagePath or package_path.
systemPrompt: Start vrcforge_inspect_outfit_package with the delegated packagePath and maxEntries. If the task needs the remaining inventory, follow sourceRead.nextRequest until complete or until the tool reports a limit with no continuation. Each page is cumulative. Report counts and coverage from the latest successful receipt in the user's language. On follow-up, reuse that receipt or continue its cursor. Never infer counts from asset names.
